assumptions.aggressor_side: a recorded trade side A is a sell aggressor and B a buy aggressor
assumptions.latency: 50 ms place and cancel latency is assumed; production delivery and order latency are not measured
assumptions.liquidation: no liquidation price is modeled (paper venue reports 0 = unknown); free margin falls back to book cash
assumptions.maker_fee_bps: 1.5 bps maker rate is the unverified scheduler/fees.go constant (issue 1726 measured no maker fill); no rebate is assumed
assumptions.min_order_value_usd: USD 10 minimum for risk-increasing quotes is an unverified venue rule; reduce-only orders below it are assumed accepted
assumptions.slippage_reserve_bps: 5 bps reserve equals the paper SlippagePct constant; it is a reserve, not a measured cost
assumptions.stop_reference: stops trigger on recorded trades and fill against recorded depth less the slippage reserve
assumptions.taker_fee_bps: 4.5 bps taker rate is the scheduler/fees.go constant, reported as a conservative upper bound by the private issue 1726 evidence

eligibility.rule: maximal receipt-time windows where raw-trade minutes are complete and valid (one minute trimmed from each end of every run of at least three complete minutes) and no l2Book coverage-break marker occurs; the first deadline is the first whole cycle after the warmup (volatility window + 1 s predecessor + maximum input age) past the window start; windows shorter than the minimum are dropped; each eligible window is cut into bounded runs of at most max_deadlines_per_run deadlines; splits are chronological over the concatenated eligible deadlines, each run starts flat with its own state, and a run never spans a split boundary

liquidation_and_margin.note: no liquidation price or venue free margin is modeled; the envelope uses book cash

maker_fee.note: the Hyperliquid maker rate for this account tier is not measured (issue 1726 found no maker fill); 1.5 bps is an unverified constant and no rebate is assumed

minimum_order_rule.note: the venue minimum order value and its reduce-only exception are not pinned from venue evidence

placement_latency.note: production delivery, placement and cancel latency are not measured; the frozen 50 ms is an assumption

lot_evidence.note: pinned Hyperliquid meta snapshot fetched 2026-10-22 for issue 1635; BTC szDecimals 5
